Required Fields on a New Payslip Batch

User manual · English · 7 steps
Learn what happens when you save a payslip batch without its name or period.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Payslips menu

Open the Payslips menu.

3. Batches

Click Batches.

4. New

Click New to start a payslip batch.

5. Save

Click the save icon without filling anything in.

6. Read the message

Read the red message. Click it to continue.

7. Discard

Click the discard icon to leave without saving.
